verdict.rationale: The evidence mentions using 'a single Hugging Face token' and bringing your own provider key. Nothing documents issuing scoped, fine-grained, or least-privilege tokens for an agent. Billing to an org via a header is an adjacent control, not credential scoping, so the axis applies but no supporting evidence exists.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can issue scoped/least-privilege API credentials for an agent
